SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari. Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi. Senior IT Business Manager Zurigo | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% possibile | Riferimento 8052 Il CIO Office di SIX supporta il CIO nel guidare l'organizzazione IT con chiarezza, attenzione e impatto. Al suo centro, l'Ufficio traduce la strategia IT in esecuzione, assicura trasparenza e allineamento attraverso l'IT e guida la consegna di iniziative chiave di trasformazione. Il ruolo di Senior IT Business Manager è una posizione centrale, volutamente ampia all'interno di questa configurazione. Offre l'opportunità di operare all'incrocio tra strategia, governance e esecuzione, con esposizione diretta al CIO e leadership senior. Cosa farai
• CIO Enablement & Executive Steering: Sostenere il CIO in argomenti chiave IT, compresa la preparazione di materiali decisionali, presentazioni di gestione e narrazioni strategiche
• Governance & Leadership Support: Orchestrare e preparare forum di governance chiave (ad esempio, formati di Consiglio e leadership) e garantire il follow-up e la trasparenza strutturati.
• Esecuzione di strategia: contribuire attivamente all'esecuzione della strategia IT e di trasformazione, compresa la gestione di iniziative interfunzionali.
• Orchestrazione interfunzionale: Collegare e coordinare gli argomenti tra le unità IT e business, tra cui la gestione delle dipendenze, delle priorità e delle escalation.
• Argomenti strategici e operativi Ad-hoc: Guidare e fornire una vasta gamma di argomenti “CIO Enablement” (ad esempio, mandati, RfP, workshop, formati di comunicazione) con alta visibilità e impatto.
• Consegna a mano attraverso i livelli: Capacità di passare tra discussioni strategiche di alto livello e esecuzione operativa dettagliata mantenendo la consistenza end-to-end. Che cosa porta
• Laurea universitaria (tecnologia, affari o simili), B.A. o superiore.
• 5-10 anni di esperienza professionale, idealmente in ambienti IT, strategia o trasformazione.
• Prove capacità di impegnarsi e collaborare con gli stakeholder senior combinati con una comunicazione chiara ed efficace.
• Hands-on, strutturato e pragmatico approccio con un forte atteggiamento “can-do” e la capacità di guidare in modo indipendente argomenti per i risultati.
• Alto impegno e motivazione, spiccata disponibilità ad assumersi la responsabilità.
• La fluenza in inglese è un must; il tedesco è un plus. Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Mateusz Kozielec al numero +41583998611 . Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette. La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale. <span class="fontcolorfe3104f33e8bf462"

Senior IT Business Manager Zurich | Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8052 The CIO Office at SIX supports the CIO in steering the IT organization with clarity, focus, and impact. At its core, the Office translates IT strategy into execution, ensures transparency and alignment across IT, and drives delivery of key transformation initiatives. The role of Senior IT Business Manager is a central, deliberately broad position within this setup. It offers the opportunity to operate at the intersection of strategy, governance, and execution, with direct exposure to the CIO and senior leadership. What You Will Do
• CIO Enablement & Executive Steering: Support the CIO in steering key IT topics, including preparation of decision materials, management presentations, and strategic narratives
• Governance & Leadership Support: Orchestrate and prepare key governance forums (e.g., Board and leadership formats) and ensure structured follow-up and transparency.
• Strategy Execution: Actively contribute to the execution of the IT and transformation strategy, including managing cross-functional initiatives.
• Cross-functional Orchestration: Connect and coordinate topics across IT and business units, including managing dependencies, priorities, and escalations.
• Ad-hoc Strategic & Operational Topics: Lead and deliver a broad variety of “CIO Enablement” topics (e.g., mandates, RfPs, workshops, communication formats) with high visibility and impact.
• Hands-on Delivery across Levels: Ability to switch between high-level strategic discussions and detailed operational execution while maintaining end-to-end consistency. What You Bring
• University degree (technology, business, or similar), B.A. or higher.
• 5-10 years of professional experience, ideally in IT, strategy, or transformation environments.
• Proven ability to engage and collaborate with senior stakeholders combined with clear and effective communication.
• Hands-on, structured and pragmatic approach with a strong “can-do” attitude and the ability to independently drive topics to results.
• High commitment and motivation, distinct readiness to take on responsibility.
• Fluency in English is a must; German is a plus. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec at +41583998611 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. <span class="fontcolorfe3104f33e8bf462"

SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran. Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen. Senior IT Business Manager Zürich | Arbeiten von zu Hause bis zu 40% möglich | Referenz 8052 Das CIO Office bei SIX unterstützt den CIO dabei, die IT-Organisation mit Klarheit, Fokus und Wirkung zu steuern. Im Kern übersetzt das Office die IT-Strategie in die Ausführung, sorgt für Transparenz und Ausrichtung in der gesamten IT und treibt die Umsetzung wichtiger Transformationsinitiativen voran. Die Rolle des Senior IT Business Managers ist eine zentrale, bewusst breite Position innerhalb dieses Setups. Es bietet die Möglichkeit, an der Schnittstelle von Strategie, Governance und Umsetzung zu operieren, mit direktem Kontakt zum CIO und zur Geschäftsleitung. Was Sie tun werden
• CIO Enablement & Executive Steering: Unterstützung des CIO bei der Steuerung wichtiger IT-Themen, einschließlich der Erstellung von Entscheidungsunterlagen, Managementpräsentationen und strategischen Erzählungen
• Governance & Leadership Support: Orchestrieren und bereiten Sie wichtige Governance-Foren (z. B. Board- und Führungsformate) vor und gewährleisten Sie eine strukturierte Nachverfolgung und Transparenz.
• Strategieausführung: Tragen Sie aktiv zur Umsetzung der IT- und Transformationsstrategie bei, einschließlich der Verwaltung funktionsübergreifender Initiativen.
• Cross-functional Orchestration: Verbinden und koordinieren Sie Themen über IT- und Geschäftseinheiten hinweg, einschließlich der Verwaltung von Abhängigkeiten, Prioritäten und Eskalationen.
• Ad-hoc Strategische und operative Themen: Führen und liefern Sie eine breite Palette von "CIO Enablement" -Themen (z. B. Mandate, RfPs, Workshops, Kommunikationsformate) mit hoher Sichtbarkeit und Wirkung.
• Hands-on Delivery across Levels: Möglichkeit, zwischen hochrangigen strategischen Diskussionen und detaillierter operativer Ausführung zu wechseln und gleichzeitig die Konsistenz von Ende zu Ende zu wahren. Was du mitbringst
• Universitätsabschluss (Technologie, Business oder ähnliches), BA oder höher.
• 5-10 Jahre Berufserfahrung, idealerweise in IT-, Strategie- oder Transformationsumgebungen.
• Bewährte Fähigkeit, hochrangige Interessengruppen zu engagieren und mit ihnen zusammenzuarbeiten, kombiniert mit einer klaren und effektiven Kommunikation.
• Hands-on, strukturierter und pragmatischer Ansatz mit einer starken „Can-do-Haltung und der Fähigkeit, Themen selbstständig zu Ergebnissen zu führen.
• Hohes Engagement und Motivation, ausgeprägte Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.
• Englisch fließend ist ein Muss; Deutsch ist ein Plus. Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Mateusz Kozielec unter +41583998611 an. Für diese Vakanz akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen. Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund. <span class="fontcolorfe3104f33e8bf462"

SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers. Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous. Directeur principal des affaires informatiques Zurich: travail à domicile jusqu'à 40% possible Le Bureau du DPI de SIX aide le DPI à diriger l'organisation de la TI avec clarté, concentration et impact. Au centre de ses activités, le Bureau traduit la stratégie informatique en exécution, assure la transparence et l'alignement dans l'ensemble des TI, et dirige la mise en oeuvre des principales initiatives de transformation. Le rôle de Senior IT Business Manager est un poste central, délibérément large dans cette configuration. Il offre l'occasion d'opérer à l'intersection de la stratégie, de la gouvernance et de l'exécution, avec une exposition directe au DPI et aux cadres supérieurs. Ce que vous ferez
• Mise en oeuvre de la DPI et direction exécutive : aider la DPI à diriger les principaux sujets de TI, y compris la préparation de documents décisionnels, de présentations de la direction et de récits stratégiques
• Soutien à la gouvernance et au leadership : orchestrez et préparez des forums clés sur la gouvernance (p. ex., le conseil d'administration et le leadership) et assurez un suivi structuré et la transparence.
• Exécution de la stratégie : Contribuer activement à l'exécution de la stratégie de TI et de transformation, y compris la gestion des initiatives interfonctionnelles.
• Orchestration interfonctionnelle : Connectez et coordonnez des sujets dans toutes les unités informatiques et commerciales, y compris la gestion des dépendances, des priorités et des escalades.
• Sujets stratégiques et opérationnels ad hoc : Diriger et offrir une grande variété de sujets d'Activation de l'ICO (p. ex. mandats, RfP, ateliers, formats de communication) avec une grande visibilité et impact.
• Exécution pratique à tous les niveaux : Capacité de passer de discussions stratégiques de haut niveau à une exécution opérationnelle détaillée tout en maintenant l'uniformité de bout en bout. Ce que vous apportez
• Diplôme universitaire (technologie, commerce, ou similaire), baccalauréat ou supérieur.
• 5-10 ans d'expérience professionnelle, idéalement dans les environnements informatiques, stratégiques ou de transformation.
• Capacité éprouvée d'engager et de collaborer avec les intervenants supérieurs, combinée à une communication claire et efficace.
• Une approche pratique, structurée et pragmatique avec une forte attitude de «can-do» et la capacité de conduire indépendamment les sujets aux résultats.
• Un engagement et une motivation élevés, une volonté d'assumer la responsabilité.
• La maîtrise de l'anglais est un must; l'allemand est un plus. Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Mateusz Kozielec au +4158399861 . Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes. La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel. <span class="fontcolorfe3104f33e8bf462"

HR Consultant Warsaw | up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 7875 Are you ready to take on a dynamic role that combines personnel management with hands-on HR advisory and coaching for managers and employees? We are looking for a dedicated and experienced professional with strong expertise in HR consulting who is passionate about making an impact. If this sounds like you, we invite you to apply for the position of HR Consultant. In this role, you will report to the Head of HR Advisory in Switzerland and collaborate with international HR consultants to support managers and employees located in Switzerland. What You Will Do
• provide guidance and support to managers and employees based in Switzerland on HR operational topics related to the full employee life cycle (recruitment, assessment, development, retention, transfer, etc.)
• ensure proper execution of HR processes to mitigate risk, while actively identifying workflow inefficiencies and driving continuous improvement
• collaborate with HRBP’s, HR Centers of Expertise and the HR Service Center to deliver cohesive and aligned HR solutions that meet business needs
• manage a variety of administrative and coordination tasks to support seamless HR operations
• coordinate and implement the annual compensation review process within the assigned area of responsibility
• work in partnership with both team members in Switzerland and global HR teams and departments, actively contributing to the implementation of Swiss and global HR projects and initiatives What You Bring
• master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline
• at least 5 years of professional experience in HR consulting or personnel management, including a minimum of 2 years working in an international HR environment, supporting European-based staff, preferably in Switzerland
• strong track record in consulting, with demonstrated problem-solving abilities and excellent interpersonal communication skills
• proven ability to function within an international matrix structure and manage diverse cultural dynamics
• proficiency in HR Information Systems (HRIS), particularly SAP SuccessFactors
• excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in German is considered a strong advantage If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. <div dir="auto" style="display:none " class="youtube874ff6b9255af776HEdBC-IF94s rtltextaligneligible row videocomponent videocomponent874ff6b9255af776 backgroundcolore700c1d7b2d8fb3c linkcolorfe3104f33e8bf

Quality Assurance Engineer Madrid | Work from home up to 40% | Reference 7648 Do you want to be part of a dynamic environment where software quality is a top priority? Are you passionate about ensuring robust, reliable, and high‑performance products? If so, our quality team wants to hear from you! We are an agile team focused on ensuring that our solutions meet the highest quality standards. We are responsible for validating key functionalities, automating tests, and continuously improving our testing processes. Our goal is to deliver an impeccable user experience and guarantee product stability in every release. In this role, you will work closely with developers, product owners, and other QA engineers, participating in the entire development lifecycle to ensure quality from day one. What You Will Do
• Design, execute, and automate backend and end‑to‑end tests using Java and JavaScript, ensuring the quality and stability of developed services.
• Validate data‑processing microservices architectures, including Spark‑ and Cloudera‑based components, as well as Kafka integrations and data consolidation/transformation checks.
• Perform and analyze performance tests using JMeter, identifying improvement areas, detecting potential bottlenecks, and producing detailed technical reports.
• Manage and document the full testing lifecycle using Xray: test case design, sprint execution, incident tracking, and functional/technical certification of releases.
• Collaborate continuously with development, business, and monitoring teams, providing technical documentation in English and defining validation procedures for deployments to production environments What You Bring
• Strong technical skills in Java and JavaScript, with proven experience in test automation using the Karate framework to ensure backend service quality and consistency.
• Solid knowledge of backend ecosystems and data‑driven environments, including Kafka integrations, Spark‑based pipeline development and validation, and experience with data‑management platforms such as Cloudera.
• Demonstrated experience with quality assurance tools and methodologies, particularly continuous integration with GitLab, performance testing with JMeter, and test lifecycle management using Xray.
• Ability to develop supporting automation scripts in Python to streamline tasks and support various testing frameworks.
• Excellent communication and documentation skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with development teams, business areas, and international stakeholders in agile environments. Senior QA Testing Lead Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8056 We are looking for an experienced and motivated Testing Lead in Madrid to join our Clearing IT team. This is an exciting opportunity for a QA professional who thrives in complex environments and wants to play a key role in shaping quality across business-critical initiatives. • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across multiple locations, fostering seamless teamwork and aligning testing activities with project milestones and release plans. What You Bring
• A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in test management, including responsibility for medium to large or complex projects, with end-to-end ownership of test strategy, execution oversight, defect management, and quality assurance governance.
• A proven track record of successfully leading test management activities across multiple releases or projects and delivering strong quality outcomes in complex environments.
• Solid understanding of Waterfall, Agile, and SAFe methodologies, with the flexibility to adapt testing approaches to different delivery models.
• Experience in coordinating and leading a team of more than six testers, providing guidance, structure, and support to achieve shared quality goals.
• Strong proficiency in JIRA for test management, change request tracking, and transparent documentation of defects, resolutions, and project progress.

descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Specialist HR Service Center (80-100%)

Zurich |  up to 40% Home Office | Reference 7951

For our dedicated Employee Lifecycle Team, we are looking for an experienced person as a Specialist HR Service Center (m/f) who will provide administrative support for the HR lifecycle from entry to exit for our line managers and employees. As part of our People Vision at SIX, we aim to continuously motivate and inspire our employees. In an exciting environment at the intersection of technology and finance within a dynamic and innovative company, SIX offers you diverse opportunities to fully contribute and develop your potential. We are a collaborative and dynamic team with a strong team spirit, shaping a culture-changing future at SIX together with the business.

The position is temporary until December 2027.

What You Will Do

• First-level support for all line managers and employees on administrative HR topics from entry to exit, as well as general labour law questions, including information on processes, time recording, absences, and fringe benefits

• Independent, accurate, and timely handling of entries, exits, and personnel changes, as well as preparation of contracts, confirmations, and employment references

• Independent updating and maintenance of personnel master data in SuccessFactors

• Responsibility for selected HR specialist topics (e.g. work permits, labour law, digitalisation, fringe benefits)

• Advising employees and line managers on all HR-related matters

What You Bring

• Commercial basic education and a higher professional qualification (e.g. HR specialist certificate)

• At least 3 years of professional experience in a similar environment

• You are passionate about administrative tasks, can think “outside the box,” enjoy proactively contributing to optimisations, and are happy to take responsibility for their implementation

• Very good user knowledge of MS Office programmes, technical affinity, SAP and/or SuccessFactors is an advantage

• Very good German and English skills, both written and spoken

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Maria Teresa Buchanan  at +41 58 399 8083 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.
